containerOverrides.name: api
command: cd /app && uv run python -c "import os, asyncio, asyncpg; dsn=os.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"]; print(\"ENV_Present\", bool(dsn)); print(\"Host\", dsn.split(\"@\")[1].split(\"/\")[0]); conn = asyncio.run(asyncpg.connect(dsn=dsn.replace(\"postgresql+asyncpg\",\"postgresql\"), timeout=10)); print(\"ASYNCPG-OK\"); asyncio.run(conn.close())"
